headline: Soybean futures ease to $12.10 per bushel as US dollar strengthens
summary: Chicago soybean futures fell to around $12.10 per bushel as a rallying U.S. dollar reduced export price competitiveness.
why: Soybeans are a primary global agricultural export used in food manufacturing and animal feed.

impacts.name: Soybeans
impacts.why: A stronger dollar made U.S. agricultural exports more expensive for foreign buyers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Strength in the U.S. dollar index pressured agricultural futures, lowering soybean contract prices.
